description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for user management within an ASP.NET Core application, including a data class for user update fields, a command for editing user info, validation logic, and a handler that processes the command by updating user data in the database.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing user profile fields that can be updated.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: A command encapsulating user data for the update operation, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation logic ensuring the command contains non-null user data.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user update command, performing database operations and returning the updated user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command by retrieving current user, updating fields, handling password hashing if needed, saving changes, and returning the updated user info.
